outputs.explanation: The lower graph is a bar chart (mean ± SD) of HMGB1 signal intensity across nuclear/cytoplasmic compartments and genotypes; no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
The lower graph is a bar chart (mean ± SD) of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells; despite N=4 mice being available, individual data points are not shown.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot showing averaged data; the check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot (time on rotarod vs. weeks) with error bars; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points would make them unreadable.
Panel E consists of line plots (rotarod time across day1-3 at 5, 9, 21 weeks) with error bars; line plots are exempt from this check.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a type of line plot, which is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel G shows micrograph images (immunofluorescence), not a plot of averaged data; the check does not apply.
Both bar charts (molecular layer thickness, number of Purkinje cells; mean ± SD, n=9 mice per group) show only summary bars with error bars, without individual data points overlaid.
